entities.summary: Magool (b. 1948-05-02, Beledweyne) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Beledweyne and Somalia. Known in the fields of somalia, composers & musicians, africa.
